PRENATAL CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Centre

QF-PCR RAPID ANEUPLOIDY SCREENING REPORT

Patient: [redacted name]
DOB: [redacted date]
Hospital Number: [redacted ID]
Specimen Type: Amniotic Fluid
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL DETAILS
Prenatal testing requested at 16 weeks gestation
Indication: Screening for chromosomal trisomies

TEST PERFORMED
Quantitative Fluorescence Polymerase Chain Reaction (QF-PCR)
Rapid aneuploidy detection for chromosomes 13, 18 and 21

METHODOLOGY
DNA extracted from uncultured amniocytes
Multiplex QF-PCR using fluorescently labelled primers for STR markers
Chromosome 13: D13S631, D13S258, D13S742, D13S628
Chromosome 18: D18S391, D18S390, D18S535, D18S386
Chromosome 21: D21S1435, D21S1411, D21S1412, D21S1446
Analysis performed on ABI 3500 Genetic Analyzer
Peak area ratios calculated for all informative markers

RESULTS

Chromosome 13: Normal diallelic pattern
- D13S631: 1.05 (normal range 0.8-1.4)
- D13S258: 1.12 (normal range 0.8-1.4)
- D13S742: Uninformative (homozygous)
- D13S628: 0.98 (normal range 0.8-1.4)

Chromosome 18: Normal diallelic pattern
- D18S391: 1.08 (normal range 0.8-1.4)
- D18S390: 0.95 (normal range 0.8-1.4)
- D18S535: 1.14 (normal range 0.8-1.4)
- D18S386: Uninformative (homozygous)

Chromosome 21: Normal diallelic pattern
- D21S1435: 1.02 (normal range 0.8-1.4)
- D21S1411: 0.91 (normal range 0.8-1.4)
- D21S1412: 1.09 (normal range 0.8-1.4)
- D21S1446: 1.11 (normal range 0.8-1.4)

Sex chromosome markers:
AMELOGENIN: XY pattern detected
TAF9: Normal male pattern

CONCLUSION
Analysis shows normal complement for chromosomes 13, 18, and 21
No evidence of trisomy 13 (Patau syndrome), trisomy 18 (Edwards syndrome), or trisomy 21 (Down syndrome)
Fetal sex: Male

LIMITATIONS
This test screens only for trisomies of chromosomes 13, 18 and 21
Does not detect balanced rearrangements, mosaicism below 20%, or other chromosomal abnormalities
Maternal cell contamination excluded (MCC markers checked)

RECOMMENDATIONS
Full karyotype analysis from cultured amniocytes to follow
This will provide comprehensive chromosomal analysis at higher resolution
Expected reporting time for karyotype: 10-14 days

Reported by: [redacted name], Clinical Scientist
Authorised by: [redacted name], Consultant Clinical Geneticist
